text:
ana: Heads-up — BrightGov support case. Over the last ~2h their embedding ingest job started failing in indexer with repeated 'dim mismatch' rejects and we saw an unexpected billing spike. Customer says they didn't change anything.
support-eng: Can you paste the indexer error and a sample payload? Need quick repro steps.
tyler: I'm on call, looking now. Initial guess: model variant swap + backfill retries.
mike: Seeing similar alerts in metrics: indexer reject rate up, queue depth spiked at 03:12 UTC.
indexer-bot: alert: indexer.prod rejects > 500/min for embeddings-indexer-01. sample log:
```
ERROR indexer: reject doc_id=bg-9427 dims=384 expected=512 reason=dim_mismatch
WARN indexer: missing idempotency_key for backfill job job=bf-2026 user=brightgov
```
ana: Customer embedding requests show model param 'open-embed-lite-384' in their payloads but our vecdb schema still expecting 512 vectors after last migration.
mike: That would explain rejects. But billing spike — looks like their backfill retried without idempotency_key so we processed duplicates then re-ingested, doubling token counts.
jess: Also saw a burst of 429s from rate-limiter before retries, then client retried aggressively, causing higher cost.
support-eng: Customer claim is they didn't change model. Could be an SDK auto-upgrade or a platform rollout that toggled default model.
tyler: Quick repro (running locally against their sample):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-lite-384","input":["text1","text2"],"metadata":{"doc_id":"bg-1"}}'
```
indexer-bot: indexer worker logs show: accept dims=384 then downstream vecdb rejected because collection schema.dimensions=512.
mike: Root cause candidates:
- Customer SDK or pipeline switched model to 384 without updating vecdb collection
- Our migration that set collection schema to 512 ran after they created some vectors at 384 (schema drift)
- Backfill retries missing idempotency caused duplicates and billing spike

ana: Customer wants immediate mitigation and a credit for the unexpected bill. They also want their backlog finished.
support-eng: Immediate mitigation plan:
- Pause their backfill job (tyler)
- Stop retries at client side if possible / suggest exponential backoff
- Open blackout for indexer workers handling BrightGov to avoid cross-impact (jess)
- Run small compatibility backfill: transform pad/truncate vectors to 512 to accept into vecdb (mike)

tyler: Paused backfill job bf-2026 at 03:40 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy: indexer-service prod rolling-restart triggered by @jess for config flag indexer.enable-dim-compat=true
mike: Quick patch in indexer: if incoming dims != collection.dim and collection.dimensions in {384,512} then attempt pad/trim with warning. Doing a canary deploy to 2 workers.
```
# pseudo
if vec.dim != collection.dim:
  if collection.dim > vec.dim: pad(vec, collection.dim, pad_value=0.0)
  else: trim(vec, collection.dim)
  log.warn('auto-adjusted-dims', original_dim=vec.dim, target=collection.dim)
```

jess: Also adding a short-term throttle on backfill concurrency to reduce billing blowup and queue pressure.
support-eng: Rebilling note: Billing team recommends creating a refund credit for the duplicate ingests, but forward-charge for legitimate unique items. Need exact counts of duplicated inserts.
mike: I'm preparing a small audit script to count duplicate ids and dims. Plan: run audit -> produce dedupe list -> run idempotent cleanup -> resume backfill with idempotency keys.
ana: Customer-facing message drafted: short apology, mitigation steps, what we'll do about credits and timeline. Sending after we confirm audit numbers.
indexer-bot: queue depth reduced after throttle. reject-rate down to baseline.
ana: Follow-ups: mike to finish patch and audit by EOD, jess to monitor for any other customers impacted, tyler to coordinate credit with billing and customer comms.
support-eng: Note for postmortem: add a gating check in onboarding to ensure vecdb collection dims match customer model, and add SDK warning if model param doesn't match pinned collection dims.
mike: Also adding storage migration tool to convert old 384 collections to 512 by padded embeddings in bulk with verification.
ana: Thanks all. I'll keep BrightGov updated. If anyone finds additional anomalies (auth expirations or other customers), ping this thread.
